what_it_does: This paper provides a comprehensive measurement study of AMD's CDNA3 GPU family (specifically MI300X and MI325X models). It characterizes how these GPUs perform on high-performance computing and AI workloads by measuring compute speed, memory bandwidth, power draw, and energy efficiency. The study uses both synthetic microbenchmarks and real-world applications to establish which GPU models work best for different types of HPC/AI problems.
